description: Run a Circle community from the terminal: spaces as files, courses as files, seat counts, and an offline mirror.

novel_features.name: Morning triage
novel_features.description: See new members, unreplied posts, flagged content, form submissions, failed charges and cancellations since a time, read from the local mirror.

novel_features.name: Declarative structure apply
novel_features.description: Make Circle's space groups and spaces match a YAML file, with a plan printed before any write.

novel_features.name: Course push
novel_features.description: Upload a course kept as module folders and markdown lessons to a Circle course space, new lessons as drafts.

novel_features.name: Course pull
novel_features.description: Download a Circle course space into module folders with one file per lesson; lesson bodies stay as Circle's HTML and media is not downloaded.

novel_features.name: Seat count
novel_features.description: Count paying members against a seat cap and list who paid.

novel_features.name: Batch onboarding
novel_features.description: Add people to the community, their spaces, space groups and access groups, and tag them, without sending invite emails by default.

novel_features.name: Founding go/no-go
novel_features.description: Answer whether at least N people paid with GO or NO-GO and the count.

novel_features.name: Recurring session scheduler
novel_features.description: Create the next Show & Tell events on a cadence by duplicating a template event.

novel_features.name: Session recap draft
novel_features.description: Pull a past session's RSVPed attendees and its live-room transcript into a markdown recap draft.
